newsitem.title: USA: Cigarette makers offer to give up research - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Cigarette makers offer to give up research - WSJ.

text.p: As part of talks to settle smoking-related disputes, two U.S. cigarette makers have offered to disclose tobacco industry research into smoking and health, the Wall Street Journal said on Thursday.
Another concession proposed at the talks was putting larger warning labels on cigarette packages, the paper said in its electronic edition.

People close to talks involving cigarette makers Philip Morris and RJR Nabisco were quoted as saying in the newspaper tobacco companies were eager to settle because of upcoming trials they could not afford to lose.
Neither company was immediately available to comment.
Both declined comment in the report.
